test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which among the following teams was defeated in the Asia Cup Finals 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sri Lanka defeated Pakistan by 23 runs to win the 6th Asia Cup.**
 
• Sri Lanka, defending the target of 171 runs, **bowled out Pakistan for 147 runs in 20 overs.**
 
• Hasaranga won the Player of the Series award for his all-around performance in the entire Asia Cup 2022 in UAE.
 
• Haris Rauf bowled brilliantly against Sri Lanka in the final of the Asia Cup.
 
 
• **He took three wickets for 29 runs in 4 overs.**
 
 
 
• Pramod Madushan was a very unknown name on the Sri Lankan team before the tournament.
 
 
• But he performed brilliantly in the Asia Cup and caught everyone's attention, in the final match, he took 4 wickets for 34 runs in 4 overs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Asia Cup

 
 
• The 2022 Asia Cup was the 15th edition of the Asia Cup cricket tournament, with matches played as Twenty20 Internationals (T20Is) during August and September 2022 in the United Arab Emirates.
 
• Host(s) - UAE
 
• Champions - Sri Lanka (6th title)
 
• Runners-up - Pakistan
 
• Participants - 6
 
• Matches - 13
 
• Player of the series - Wanindu Hasaranga (Sri Lanka)
 
• Most runs - Pakistan Mohammad Rizwan (281)
 
• Most wickets - India Bhuvneshwar Kumar (11)
